method: Apply the same fixed response parser used by evaluation to every one of 600 official reference responses; group by task. No examples are filtered or scores adjusted.

manual_review_of_parser_mismatches.issue: Reference asks the user to supply a bearing description rather than diagnosing the provided signal. A generic fault-free mention is parsed as class0. This is an incomplete maintenance answer, not evidence of an incorrect signal label.
manual_review_of_parser_mismatches.model_response: Generated text exactly matches the normalized reference, demonstrating that high ROUGE can reproduce an unhelpful reference.

manual_review_of_parser_mismatches.issue: Reference asks for a bearing description and does not diagnose a state; parser returns -1. This is an incomplete risk-analysis answer, not evidence of an incorrect signal label.
manual_review_of_parser_mismatches.model_response: Generated text exactly matches the normalized reference, demonstrating that high ROUGE can reproduce an unhelpful reference.

scope_caveat: The 150-example standard classification task is distinct from these maintenance/risk text issues. Lexical overlap and parser consistency do not establish factual correctness or maintenance safety.

separate_observed_generation_errors.note: An actual generated wrong class; the official reference gives the expected class. Original accuracy scoring is retained.
